rules.name: ROAS Underclaim Alert
rules.reason: Monitor campaigns where the platform's reported ROAS significantly under-reports actual ROAS.

rules.name: High Social to Acquisition Rate
rules.reason: Campaigns with low conversion efficiency from social reach may need optimization.

rules.name: Customer Support Ticket Spike
rules.reason: A spike in customer support tickets may indicate underlying product or service issues.

rules.name: Negative Customer Feedback
rules.reason: Low average sentiment scores indicate customer dissatisfaction that should be addressed.

rules.name: Low Customer NPS
rules.reason: A low Net Promoter Score suggests that improvements in customer experience are needed.

rules.name: High Refund Rate
rules.reason: High refund rates can indicate product quality or fulfillment issues.

rules.name: Product Health Score Warning
rules.reason: A low health score may suggest potential product or supply chain issues.

rules.name: Inventory Confirmation Risk
rules.reason: Unconfirmed inventory poses a risk for fulfilling customer orders timely.

rules.name: Cx Risk Score Alert
rules.reason: High customer experience risk scores require attention to prevent dissatisfaction.

rules.name: Ads Status Check
rules.reason: Inactive ad statuses need investigation to prevent loss of potential revenue.

rules.name: Sentiment Mismatch Alert
rules.reason: Large mismatches in sentiment analysis can indicate that customer feedback may not be accurately represented.

rules.name: Average Rating Drop
rules.reason: A drop in average customer rating suggests declining satisfaction.
